questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion for emphasis in a hypothetical scenario involving a hypothetical condition?
options: If it were possible to travel through time, we would have learnt the answer sooner.
Had she known the truth, she would never have left him.
Unless he had studied harder, he wouldn’t have passed the exam.
Only when the evidence was presented clearly did the jury reach their decision.
questions.answer: Had she known the truth, she would never have left him.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a cleft construction to express emphasis on the *reason* for a situation?
options: It was because of his dedication that he achieved such success.
The reason he failed was that he didn’t study enough.
What surprised everyone was the unexpected turn of events.
It was only after the meeting that he realised the importance of the task.
questions.answer: The reason he failed was that he didn’t study enough.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a third conditional with the subjunctive mood in a formal context?
options: If I had known she was coming, I would have invited her to dinner.
If she were to win the award, she would be the first woman in history to do so.
Had he been more careful, he wouldn’t have broken his leg in the accident.
Unless you had given me the data earlier, we wouldn’t have completed the report on time.
questions.answer: If she were to win the award, she would be the first woman in history to do so.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates ellipsis with a formal and nuanced use of omitted clauses?
options: She didn’t come to the party last night—she was too busy preparing for her exam.
It’s not that I don’t like him; it’s just that he’s always late.
The meeting was cancelled because there was no quorum present.
He didn’t finish the project on time, but he assured us he would complete it soon.
questions.answer: It’s not that I don’t like him; it’s just that he’s always late.

questions.question: Which sentence uses a complex structure involving a passive construction, a conditional clause, and a formal register to express regret?
options: Had I known the rules better, I would have avoided that mistake.
The fact that she didn’t attend the conference was unfortunate, as it meant we missed critical updates.
If only he had taken the advice, the situation wouldn’t have escalated so quickly.
It was regrettable that the agreement was not finalised in time, given the urgency of the matter.
questions.answer: It was regrettable that the agreement was not finalised in time, given the urgency of the matter.
